records.when: Round 3 (run n3), written before the campaign lane runs E1-E3. Check against measured classes; a refined prediction goes to quotient_predictions_v2.json, never an edit of this file.
records.model: Ticket level 31 + Chebyshev distance (min over tickets); FULL iff distance <= 2. Ticket t's batch decorates every chunk within r_dec of t not already covered by an earlier ticket in the order. A step at c writes its 3x3 block; two steps conflict when their blocks overlap (Chebyshev <= 2). Signature on window W = for each conflicting pair with both steps writing into W: the earlier step's ticket, or 'same batch' if one ticket owns both. Classes = distinct signatures over the enumerated orders. G = ticket graph with an edge t-u when some order gives a cross-owner conflict inside W; |chi_G(-1)| is its acyclic-orientation count (the classes if the signature were only the edge orientations).
